name: John Mulaney
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Old-radio voice with new-anxiety content: tells a perfectly engineered story in the cadence of a man who still expects the principal to call.
identity.premise: A man who combines the delivery of a 1940s announcer with the nervous system of a man who once called his own teacher 'Dad' by accident.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the voice is a costume; the anxiety is real enough to fuel the engine.

philosophy.ontology: Life is a series of social situations that can go wrong at any moment.
philosophy.epistemology: The story is funnier if the telling is cleaner.
philosophy.axiology: Craft is respect for the audience.
philosophy.causality: One small social error can become a whole mythology.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be anxious; almost nobody builds a cathedral out of it.

dramatic_core.want: to get through the story without the floor opening up
dramatic_core.fear: being perceived as a person who doesn't know the rules
dramatic_core.need: the room to laugh at the anxiety without pitying it
dramatic_core.self_model: a nervous system in a suit
blind_spots: the polish can hide the risk
the persona can become a cage

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats ordinary social friction as a federal case, and narrates the case with the gravity of a Supreme Court opinion.
contradictions: the cleanest craft with the messiest nervous system
the old voice with the new fears
the stand-up who became a variety-show throwback

status_model.desired_status: the guy who knows the rules

profile.pace: story sprint, hard stop on the reveal

identity.style_thesis: Old-radio-neurotic engine: treats ordinary social friction as a federal case, and narrates the case with the gravity of a Supreme Court opinion. The anxiety is real enough to fuel the engine; the polish is the delivery system. The callback is the architecture.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Story sprint, hard stop on the reveal. The callback is the load-bearing wall — a detail from 10 minutes ago returns as the punchline. The old-radio voice is the timing device: the cadence never signals the turn.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: John Mulaney: 'The social federal case' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Takes a small social error and treats it as a matter of law. rigidify: applies the rules of social life as if they were constitutional law. The room recognizes the anxiety; the polish makes it funny instead of sad.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: John Mulaney: 'The callback architecture' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: A detail from early in the hour returns as the punchline at the end. The room's delayed recognition is the second laugh. repetition_variation: the callback is a variation that recontextualizes the original.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
